summary: The AD channel-UB retraction is substantively complete in live non-workflow files: the listed docs/scripts now consistently distinguish AD Choi-state quantities from channel-level bounds, the `e_r_channel_ppt` docstring caveat is scientifically sound, the WLC test fix to `0.5` matches `wlc.py:483`, and the §9 retraction-cycle table in the session summary matches the round-by-round review artifacts at a high level. I did not find a residual live AD overclaim. I am not passing the round because a few minor accuracy/bookkeeping issues remain in the retraction memo and data-preservation story.

issues.description: The memo says the 'channel-level REE converse requires teleportation-covariance / teleportation-simulability.' That is too strong. Teleportation-covariance is needed to collapse channel REE to the Choi-state quantity `E_R(J_N)`, not for the existence of a channel-level REE converse itself.
issues.suggestion: Reword this line to say that using the Choi state as the channel REE converse requires teleportation-covariance/simulability, or explicitly distinguish `E_R(N)` from `E_R(J_N)`.

issues.description: The changelog still says the plot-title retraction was 'flagged for next revision,' but the same memo already records the plot/script as corrected and regenerated at lines 102-103. That leaves stale status prose inside the final retraction record.
issues.suggestion: Update the changelog entry to reflect the completed state, so the memo does not imply an unfinished fix that was already applied.

issues.description: Compared with commit `6b31c70`, the scientific columns are preserved, but the CSV is not literally unchanged: the `sdp_time_s` values were regenerated. That means the 'data preserved / CSV unchanged' methodology claim is only true for the physics results, not for the full artifact byte-for-byte.
issues.suggestion: If byte-stable preservation matters for auditability, keep runtime metadata out of the canonical CSV or document explicitly that only `gamma`, `E_R_PPT_SDP`, `log_neg_analytic`, and `Q_LB_on_K2way` were preserved while timing metadata was refreshed.

round_recommendation: Tighten the AD memo wording around channel REE vs Choi-state REE, fix the stale changelog line, and clarify or stabilize the CSV-preservation story. After that, this set is ready for PASS.
